Hard line breaks rendered with backslash

```kotlin title="Kotlin (Android)"
import io.xberg.android.*
import com.fasterxml.jackson.module.kotlin.jacksonObjectMapper

fun main() {
    val mapper = jacksonObjectMapper()
    val options = mapper.readValue("{\"newline_style\":\"Backslash\"}", ConversionOptions::class.java)
    val result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert("<p>Line one<br>Line two</p>", options)
    println(result)
}
```
